evidence.role: Calculates one aggregate fee before branching and assigns all residual units to sponsor proceeds.

evidence.role: Establishes that the invoked three-argument mulDiv overload rounds down.

evidence.quote: uint256 internal constant BPS = 10_000; ... uint256 internal constant PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS = 500; ... uint256 internal constant CASH_WINNER_BPS = 8000;
evidence.role: Fixes the denominator and allocation rates.

reasoning: Both settlement entrypoints converge on one private routine that computes the protocol fee once from the aggregate unsettled pot. The invoked three-argument Math.mulDiv implementation explicitly floors the full-precision quotient. Both NftWon and CashWon then derive sponsor proceeds by subtraction from the same gross pot, so winner plus sponsor plus protocol liabilities equal the original pot exactly. This is implemented rather than partial or contradicted because every fee-bearing branch shares that calculation and no alternate writer or formula exists.
